title: Benches & Daybeds
lead: Upholstered and storage benches for the end of a bed or an entry, and deep daybeds with cushions and pillows.
intro: Every piece has a number, like Bench No. 07 or Daybed No. 02. Ask about it by number and we will come back with sizes, finishes, pricing and lead time.

models.name: Lift-Top Storage Bench
models.summary: A cream upholstered bench with a lift-up top and storage inside, on a slim wood plinth.
models.more: The top lifts up for storage, and the upholstered box sits on a slim wood plinth.

models.name: Tapered-Leg Upholstered Bench
models.summary: An upholstered bench on tapered wood legs, as an open bench or with a lift-top storage box.
details: Open bench or lift-top storage version
models.more: Choose the open bench or the storage version with a lift-up top, both on tapered wood legs.

models.name: Wood-Frame Cushion Bench
models.summary: A cream cushion on a light wood frame with tapered legs; also as a storage bench.
details: Light wood frame with tapered legs
Storage version with a closed base
models.more: A cream cushion sits on a light wood frame, and there's a storage version with a closed base.

models.name: Shelf-Base Bench
models.summary: An upholstered bench on a light wood frame with a shelf below; also as a storage bench.
models.more: There's an open shelf below the seat, and a storage version in textured fabric.

models.name: Channel-Tufted Storage Bench
models.summary: A channel-tufted storage bench in cream on dark block feet, plus a white bench with low arms.
models.more: The tufted top lifts for storage, and a white version with low arms is shown too.

models.name: Bolster-End Bench
models.summary: An upholstered bench on a slim brass-tone frame, with round cushions at each end.
models.more: Round cushions cap each end of the seat, on a slim brass-tone frame.

models.name: Cast-Metal Bench
models.summary: An upholstered top on a cast brass-tone frame, with straight or crossed legs.
details: Upholstered top in white or gray
Straight legs or curved X legs
models.more: The top comes in white or gray, on straight legs or curved X legs.

models.name: Cognac Cast-Frame Bench
models.summary: A cognac leather-look top on a cast brass-tone frame with a crossed stretcher.
details: Crossed stretcher with a ring detail
models.more: A cognac leather-look top rides on a cast brass-tone frame, with a ring where the stretchers cross.

models.name: Rolled-Arm Leather-Look Bench
models.summary: A cognac leather-look bench with rounded ends that roll up into arms.
details: Rounded ends that roll up into arms
models.more: The ends roll up into soft arms, all in a cognac leather look.

models.name: Slim-Frame Leather-Look Bench
models.summary: A gray leather-look cushion on a slim brass-tone frame.
models.more: A gray leather-look cushion on a slim, squared brass-tone frame.

models.name: Channel-Tufted Block Bench
models.summary: A solid block of gray channel-tufted upholstery.
details: Vertical channel tufting on every side
models.more: Channel tufting wraps all four sides, over a low recessed base.

models.name: Hide-Look Sled-Leg Bench
models.line: Black hide look, brass-tone sled legs
models.summary: A black hair-on-hide-look top on brass-tone sled legs.
models.more: The black hide-look top sits on two brass-tone sled legs.

models.name: Three-Pad Arched-Leg Bench
models.summary: Three cushioned pads on a brass-tone frame with arched legs.
models.more: Three separate cushion pads sit on a brass-tone frame with arched legs.

models.name: Reeded Daybed
models.summary: A deep cushioned daybed with raised ends, wrapped in reeded wood.
models.more: Reeded wood wraps the frame and the raised ends, with a cream cushion and pillows.

models.name: Textured-Frame Daybed
models.summary: A daybed with a textured natural-tone frame and a cognac leather-look cushion and pillows.
models.more: The frame has a textured natural tone, with a cognac leather-look cushion and pillows.

models.name: Bolster Daybed
models.summary: A long upholstered daybed on slim wood legs, with bolsters and pillows.
details: Shown in light gray and brown
models.more: A long, low upholstered platform on slim wood legs, shown in light gray and in brown.

models.name: Curved Wood Daybed
models.summary: A daybed in a curved wood shell with a cognac leather-look cushion; also as a one-ended chaise.
details: Chaise version with one raised end
models.more: A curved wood shell holds a cognac leather-look cushion, and there's a chaise version with one raised end.

models.name: Cast-Frame Bolster Chaise
models.summary: A cream upholstered daybed on a cast brass-tone frame, with bolsters at one or both ends.
details: Bolster at one or both ends
models.more: Bolsters sit at one or both ends of a cream seat, on a cast brass-tone frame.

models.name: Rounded Wood Daybed
models.summary: A light wood daybed with rounded ends and a cream cushion.
models.more: Rounded light wood ends hold a cream cushion and pillows.
